---
title: "Getting Started"
format: html
---

The quickest way to start with Quarto is to work in [Posit Cloud](https://posit.cloud).

- Create a FREE Posit Cloud account ([Sign up](https://posit.cloud/plans/free))
- Open the following [Posit Cloud project](https://posit.cloud/content/12857826) called "Quarto Tutorial"
- Work through the three tutorials:
  - [Tutorial: Hello, Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/hello/rstudio.html)
  - [Tutorial: Computations](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/computations/rstudio.html)
  - [Tutorial: Authoring](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/authoring/rstudio.html)

::: callout-note
Open the "Get Started" folder in the "Quarto Tutorial" project to find the Quarto files associated with the three tutorials above. The completed versions of the files are located in the "Completed" subfolder.
:::

If you would like to install Quarto on your computer, visit the [Get Started](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) page.
